title: The Dispatch Requests an Interview
description: Nadia Voss from the Ashenmere Dispatch has formally requested an interview about the Bureau of National Integrity's archival records. Her office has filed three separate requests over the past month. She has found something, or believes she has.

title: Constitutional Draft — Final Review
description: The final draft is circulating. The referendum is four weeks away. Every word now is the word that will appear on the ballot. Review the complete text before it goes to print.

title: Budget Allocation — Pre-Referendum Framework
description: The referendum will consume the government's attention for the next month. Set the fiscal framework now so the treasury doesn't drift while the political class is focused on the constitution.

title: General Brenner — Pre-Referendum Assessment
description: Brenner wants to brief you on the military's institutional position regarding the referendum. He has been careful not to state a preference. That is itself a statement from a man whose predecessor helped plan the Halvek takeover.

title: The Residence — After Dark
description: Jonas left a note on your desk — not in an envelope, just a folded piece of paper with your name in his handwriting. The children are asking when you'll be home for dinner. He says he told them 'soon.' He didn't say whether he believed it.

title: BCA Report
description: The Bureau of Cultural Affairs has submitted its weekly report.

title: SSD Report
description: The State Security Directorate has submitted its weekly report.

title: What Serida Heard
description: Serida enters your office and closes the door. She heard something in the hallway outside the document registry.

title: The Price of Black Gold
description: The Foreign Minister's telegram arrived at six in the morning.

title: The Same Cell
description: The Arcturian intelligence cell watching Dr. Voss — it is the same cell that ran Yelena Dorova.

title: Protest or Riot
description: Twelve thousand in Republic Square. A counter-demonstration has appeared. The Commissioner is requesting guidance.
